name: Almessa Tsen'thos
source:
Affiliation: The Council of Races
Location: Gregorian Cluster
Relationship: None
Personnel File: Next to nothing is known of High Councillor Almessa's History. She is thousands of years old, and served on the Council before any of it's current races, when it was located in the Furies Nebula. She has a reputation of being unbiased, and adhering strictly to protocols. She is invaluable in conflict resolution, and has been known to provide advice to key galactic figures.
